name: Hello Again
source:
Up in the mountains, looking down on the port and the industrial sector of the city stands Setogiwa Academy. It is the country’s only school with facilities to research the special abilities that have started rapidly appearing since the turn of the century. Top scholars, wanting the honor of naming the so-called psychic powers that (supposedly) lie dormant in their students, have dubbed it “DA” and have developed a program to train and research these powers. 

However, it’s not like the students have the kind of invincible super powers you’d see ESPers using in old manga and movies.

Their powers are a little mysterious, and possibly convenient, but aren’t quite good for anything useful. Apparently, that’s all DA is, at least according to current research. 

And so, the students at Setogiwa Academy live almost completely normal lives. Just with some slightly bizarre events attached...

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1489]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
濑户际学园坐落在群山之中，俯瞰城市港口和工业区。这里是全国唯一配备设施、研究世纪之交以来迅速涌现的特殊能力的学校。顶尖学者希望取得为学生体内（据说）沉睡的超能力命名的荣誉，将其称为“DA”，并制定了训练和研究这些能力的计划。

然而，学生们拥有的并不是旧漫画和电影中超能力者使用的那种无敌力量。

他们的能力有些神秘，或许偶尔方便，却算不上真正有用。至少根据目前的研究，DA似乎仅此而已。

因此，濑户际学园的学生们过着几乎完全普通的生活，只是偶尔会附带一些略显离奇的事件…

[翻译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1489]Getchu.com[/url]的简介]
